parts:
Hi everyone

Last chance to join our 1-day seminar Peer Reviewing and Editing Journals livestreaming January 8 with Carlton Fong (Department of Curriculum and Instruction, Texas State University). This seminar offers practical strategies for engaging in peer review and journal editing, essential skills for ensuring the rigor and impact of scholarly work. By mastering efficient review workflows and understanding editorial perspectives, researchers using lavaan can enhance the quality of their own submissions and critically evaluate studies employing advanced statistical modeling. These skills empower you to contribute to the methodological integrity of your field, ensuring that research involving latent variable analysis is robustly assessed and effectively communicated.

Sign up today to secure your spot, and feel free to share this opportunity with colleagues and students who might benefit!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Professor and Director
